notIdeasOfWhatSocietyShouldBe.explanation: The term is a law-enforcement label for violence defined by lacking an ideology or political goal. I went through the 598 statements against the ISD report (the only defining source I could open: the FBI statement, PolitiFact and Lawfare pages returned 404 to every download agent) and none could be answered: ISD says its perpetrators 'are not seeking to change society or promote a specific ideological outcome', and the one society-related line it quotes ('societal standards should not exist') comes from a single member group (No Lives Matter), which is not the label's own position. Fewer than two answerable positions.

sources.title: Terror without ideology? The rise of nihilistic violence - Institute for Strategic Dialogue
